backdrop.why: The backdrop is prompted, one word, the only free operand in the key's |pixel - backdrop| - and it is fixture data, not a default. Derive by the galleon's method: maximise the minimum distance from every declared material (canon/DRAGON-IDENTITY.md D1-D11, colours estimated to sRGB first), weighted toward D3 (storm-grey membranes, the largest near-neutral surface - the danger class on THIS subject) and the dark small elements; saturated optima disqualified (a saturated backdrop bleeds into a diffusion image). W3's grey and the galleon's white are candidates, neither inherited. Pre-register the prediction before any generation.

_still_suspended.thin_extent: OWNED BY THE MEASUREMENT DISPATCH. Per-mesh by law; the ship's 0.01 is filament-derived and a membrane is not a filament. Measure the extent density on the designated mesh, publish the full cost curve (fraction of visible area withheld per view per candidate value), and report SEPARATELY what fraction of the membrane fields the mask withholds - a filament-tuned value could withhold a third of this subject. Also report the pinch-field's behaviour under the facing/visibility chain (the 7,138-edge region) as diagnostic evidence for the spec's arms. The texpass_iter block deliberately carries NO thin-extent key until this lands - the coverage check SHOULD flag it, and any arm before then is off-route by the sweep gate. SHARPENED 2026-08-05 (handoff 2 Task 1, E12 Ruling 5): the TOOL default is 0.0, not a character number - undecided means the thin guard runs DISABLED, not that 0.03 arrives by silence. One more reason no arm precedes the measurement.
